assumptions.statement: The submitted site polygon is the maintained provisional boundary and is used only for relationship diagrams, local checks, and replaceable concept geometry.
assumptions.impact: Site area and all ratios must be recomputed when the official boundary is supplied; no statutory redline or land-right conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional placeholders aligned to the current site package and do not replace official detailed-design boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Key-area design is a spatial relationship proposal only; areas, access, ownership, and implementation limits remain open.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage constraints, and engineering conditions are not available in the current public package.
assumptions.impact: Building density, floor-area ratio, height, setbacks, parking, and construction decisions remain unknown and must not be inferred from conceptual geometry.

assumptions.statement: The road layer contains one conceptual commons spine and three cross-links for connectivity reasoning, not official road centerlines or transport assignments.
assumptions.impact: Traffic organization, transit access, crossings, emergency routes, and parking require a transport and safety review.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries, land rights, leases, and development obligations are absent from the design input.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish and renewal projects are reversible discussion items, not property, acquisition, or construction recommendations.

assumptions.statement: Building objects are conceptual footprints with no claim about existing survey, structure, fire separation, height, or floor area.
assumptions.impact: The footprint metrics support geometry checks only; architectural, structural, fire, and accessibility review is still required.

assumptions.statement: A complete heritage inventory, rights-cleared archive, and approved interpretation text are not present.
assumptions.impact: The railway-memory narrative remains abstract and must be cleared item by item before public display or reproduction.

assumptions.statement: Water, drainage, power, fire, communications, waste, network, and maintenance capacities are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Municipal elements are a service-first checklist; no capacity, engineering, or operational performance is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Public facility catchments, staffing, opening hours, transit schedules, and emergency-service capacity are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards describe service protocols and fallback paths, not promised availability or response times.

assumptions.statement: No personal data, face data, individual trajectory, or private operational dataset is needed for this package.
assumptions.impact: Future testing must use minimum, aggregated, or synthetic data with consent, retention, and human review defined before any operation.
